label_note: The SAME submissions as labels.json, graded against a rubric that gives only the questions and their marks -- no criteria at all. The expected scores are deliberately identical to the detailed-rubric run, because the quality of the work has not changed: only the amount of help the grader was given has. Large drops here mean the grader cannot judge correctness on its own and is merely checking answers against supplied criteria; scores close to the detailed run mean it is genuinely reading the work. Compare the two runs, not this one in isolation.
